Shoulder thrust-face60 and shoulder finish70 precede reliefs80/90; the integral Ø10 shoulder is retained and both real shoulder reliefs are covered. No drill/ream/tap precedence is applicable.
findings.subject: S1

evidence: Explicit rechuck and tailstock withdrawal precede op10 removal of the sacrificial north allowance; op10 establishes the temporary apex pickup face before dome20.
No centre seat or flat end survives as an invented final feature.
findings.subject: S2

evidence: Declared prerequisite is measurement of the installed-ear span; explicit rechuck precedes fit-cut10, repickup and south-dome20.
The dependency order is valid even though the required actual span and corresponding absolute cut coordinate remain absent; this is not a claimed completed fit.
findings.subject: S3

evidence: policy.yaml is a byte-for-byte copy of examples/policy/default.yaml; all 14 M1/M1b rules are required.
Plan does not remove or downgrade rules. coverage severity is warn; every other rule severity is block.
findings.subject: policy

evidence: Reference fixture uses typed shaft/face features, three explicit setups, complete structured x/y/z pickups and resolvable feature/operation references; no hole, thread or unsupported indexing subject is manufactured.
All report statuses and severity labels follow the 14-rule consumer policy. This is an authored expected result, not output from an implemented checker.
